title: OpenSoha Network Runtime Protocol Message
description: Strict, versioned control messages exchanged by network-control, endpoint services and network gateways. Private keys and raw authentication credentials are intentionally excluded.

admissionPolicyVersion.description: Admission policy version last read from Core, independent of applied VPN configuration.

IPv4CIDR.description: Canonical IPv4 CIDR; use IPCIDR for either supported address family.

credentialReference.description: Opaque reference to runtime-local protected storage, never raw credential material.

IPCIDR.description: Non-default IPv4 or IPv6 CIDR syntax. Core additionally validates canonical network-address bits and compressed address spelling with netip.
